crossRefs.note: He takes the wise in their own craftiness; the counsel of the cunning is carried headlong.
There is no wisdom nor understanding nor counsel against Yahweh.
Who is he who says, and it comes to pass, when the Lord doesn’t command it?
For the wisdom of this world is foolishness with God. For it is written, “He has taken the wise in their craftiness.”

translations.web: But Paul’s sister’s son heard they were lying in wait, and he came and entered into the barracks and told Paul.
translations.bsb: But when the son of Paul’s sister heard about the plot, he went into the barracks and told Paul.
translations.kjv: And when Paul's sister's son heard of their lying in wait, he went and entered into the castle, and told Paul.
translations.asv: But Paul's sister's son heard of their lying in wait, and he came and entered into the castle and told Paul.
